#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
#define BS bitset < 128 >
unordered_map < BS , int > id;
int N, cnt, P[7][7], dp[2][70003], trans[70003][128], prob[128], inv100;

int modpow(long long a, int b) {
    int res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int get_id(BS &x) {
    auto it = id.find(x);
    if (it != id.end()) return it->second;
    int cur = id[x] = ++cnt;
    BS tmp[7], tp;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j)
            if (x[j]) tmp[i][j | (1 << i)] = 1;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
        tp = x;
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            if (mask >> j & 1) tp |= tmp[j];
        trans[cur][mask] = get_id(tp);
    }
    return cur;
}

int main() {
    cin >> N;
    BS start; start.set(0);
    get_id(start);
    inv100 = modpow(100, MOD - 2);
    cerr << id.size() << endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            cin >> P[i][j];
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    int cur = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            prob[mask] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                int val = (mask >> k & 1) ? P[i][k] : (100 - P[i][k]);
                prob[mask] = 1LL * prob[mask] * val % MOD * inv100 % MOD;
            }
        }
        memset(dp[cur ^= 1], 0, sizeof(dp[cur]));
        for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; ++j) {
            if (dp[cur ^ 1][j]) {
                int base = dp[cur ^ 1][j];
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
                    int nxt = trans[j][mask];
                    dp[cur][nxt] = (dp[cur][nxt] + 1LL * base * prob[mask]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    BS full;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); ++i) full.set(i);
    cout << dp[cur][id[full]] << endl;
    return 0;
}
